attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"local rumors suggest a mutiny or a visit from the Embertail Tribe","reason":"Briefing gives no rumours or cause of death"},{"span":"The Gray Wharf Syndicate has increased patrols near the coast","reason":"Event not in briefing"},{"span":"a conflict that has yet to produce any notable results","reason":"Briefing gives no outcome of the war"}],"voice":1,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"It breaks character by copying the briefing's section headings (\"News since your last bulletin:\", \"Already reported:\") into the bulletin, and it reads as flat summary rather than Odile's sardonic voice.
